quote: The Company and NVIDIA entered into a collaboration framework to expand their long-standing complementary relationship to advance AI adoption at global scale and to accelerate the Company's buildout of more than 5 gigawatts of artificial intelligence factories by 2030 developed and operated by the Company using NVIDIA's computing platform technology.
trigger_description: subject to the terms and conditions of the collaboration framework and future execution of additional agreements and/or order forms and the satisfaction of certain conditions
